data: Which of the following domains is not represented in the graph?

The caption states that the figure shows the increase in log-likelihood of the data per-iteration in the five domains. The domains mentioned in the caption are Movies, Music, Books, Food, and Electronics. The graph contains five lines, each representing one domain. Therefore, all five domains are represented in the graph. 

To determine which domain is not represented, we need to identify any domain listed in the caption but not shown in the graph. However, since all five domains are explicitly mentioned in the caption and there are exactly five lines in the graph, no domain is missing.

Thus, the answer is that none of the domains are not represented in the graph.
